getPart

public char getPart()
Indicates which part of the whole cartouche to draw. other codes : for standard MDC cartouches, the whole information is in the opening part. with possible values of b, m, e or 'a' for the whole cartouche.
b
beginnning of a cartouche
m
middle of a cartouche
e
end of a cartouche
a
the whole cartouche. Not in the "manual"

Returns:
value of part.
